full_judgment:
Hasan Foez Siddique J. This appeal is directed against the Judgment and order dated 06.07.1999 passed by the High Court Division in Civil Revision No.185 of 1998 reversing the Judgment and decree dated 30.11.1997 passed by the learned District Judge, Khulna in Title Appeal No. 90 of 1997 reversing those dated 26.01.1997 passed by the learned Subordinate judge 3rd court, Khulna in title Suit No. 51 of 1996. 

 4. Learned Subordinate Judge decreed the suit. 

 5. Appeal, preferred by the petitioners, was allowed. Then the plaintiff filed Civil Revision in the High Court Division and a Division Bench of the High Court Division by the impugned judgment made the said Rule absolute on setting aside judgment and decree of the appellate court. Then the defendants preferred this appeal getting leave. 

 8. Mr. Tofilure Rahman submits that the High Court Division has committed error of law in reversing the findings of facts arrived at by the last court of facts on proper consideration of the evidence on record. He submits that though there was no error of law resulting in an error in the decision occasioning failure of justice in the judgment and decree of the court of facts but the revisional court illegally set a side the same. 

 11. Accordingly, the appeal is allowed. The judgment and order dated 06.07.1999 passed by the High Court Division in Civil Revision No. 185 of 1998 is hereby set aside. Consequently, Judgment and decree of the Appellate Court is restored.
